Karela Powder Exporter: Introduction to Karela Powder

Karela powder, also sold as bitter gourd or bitter melon powder, is a dehydrated vegetable powder used by tea, supplement, herbal and snack manufacturers. Tradenest Naturals supplies it as a karela powder exporter to buyers worldwide. We work with fresh bitter gourd that is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Our bitter gourd powder bulk grade keeps the vegetable's typical green colour and sharp, bitter taste, batch after batch.

Karela Powder Processing

Raw bitter gourd is cleaned, sliced, dehydrated at controlled temperatures and milled to a fine powder. Buyers sometimes ask us for spray dried karela powder. Our standard grade is dehydrated and milled rather than spray dried, so please tell us if your formulation needs a specific format. The process keeps the natural bitterness and colour of the vegetable without synthetic additives.

Quality Assurance and Purity Standards

Each batch is checked for moisture, mesh size, colour and appearance. We keep batch traceability from raw material through to export packing. Production follows documented food-safety practices in our FSSAI registered facility. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Key Applications and Industries Served

Our bulk karela powder supply from India serves several sectors. Food and beverage brands add it to herbal teas, tonics and drink mixes. Ayurvedic and herbal companies use our bitter melon powder wholesale grade in capsules, tablets and traditional formulations. Snack makers blend it into savoury seasonings and dry mixes.

Buyer Value and Advantages

Tradenest Naturals offers a low MOQ, samples on request and clear wholesale pricing. Our export packaging is designed to protect the powder from moisture during long-distance transit. As an IEC registered exporter, we provide export documentation support and ship worldwide from India. OEM and private label packing is also available.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for karela powder? The MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger bulk and private label orders are quoted on request. What certifications and quality standards apply? We are an FSSAI registered food business. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We offer 1 kg pouches, bulk export bags and custom private label packs. Shelf life is 24 months when stored cool and dry. What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)? The powder is dehydrated, milled to 80-100 mesh, with moisture of 7.0% or less. It is a single-ingredient bitter gourd powder. What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote? Lead time depends on order size and packaging, and we confirm it with each quotation. Contact our sales team to request a quote or sample.
